checks.name: readme_setup_correctness
checks.detail: DEFECT FOUND BY MAIN AND FIXED. The first README draft instructed `.venv/bin/pip install -e .` -- precisely the RK15/D-B command the plan forbids. Main reproduced the failure in a scratch dir replicating the flat layout: 'Multiple top-level packages discovered in a flat-layout: [app, data, plans, harness]', build rejected. Doubly broken: this repo's .venv was made by `uv venv`, which installs no pip, so .venv/bin/pip does not exist. Setup now uses the exact phase-1 uv commands plus a stdlib-venv fallback with no `-e .` and no `.`, and a Vietnamese note explaining why the project is never installed as a package. Subagent re-verified BOTH paths in throwaway scratch dirs: uv path installed 21 packages exit 0; stdlib path installed all 5 pins and imported them cleanly. The residual `-e .` occurrence in README is inside that explanatory note (documenting what NOT to do), which is intended.
